package.name: pendulum_tools
package.description: PyQt5 GUI tools for the LDR pendulum testbed. Ships action_position_sender, a hybrid action-client / topic-publisher that auto-discovers ros2_control controllers (JointTrajectoryController via FollowJointTrajectory, or any JointGroup position controller via Float64MultiArray on the controller's commands topic), parses joint limits from /robot_description, and persists named poses to YAML.
